gap: No result ChatGPT got states that every 8–12 kWh kit sold with its panels as one listing by a portable-station maker is a pre-order today (Jackery 5000 Plus ships Dec 2, Anker S5000 10 kWh + 2×400 W in 11–12 weeks, BLUETTI Apex 300 + 2× B300K late January 2027), or prices them side by side per Wh and per hour of rated sun ($0.53 to $0.84 per Wh, 8 to 21 hours) against Sun Gold Power's 10.24 kWh + 3,600 W component kit at $4,949 ($0.48 per Wh, 2.8 hours).
standout_why: Opened four rival pages; none prices a 10 kWh kit with panels per Wh or gives refill hours from the kit's own panels. StormWatts' 240 V page (cited) prices stations only, has Jackery's 10 kWh version at $6,199 without panels and the S5000 pre-order at 9–10 weeks (Anker's page now says 11–12). StormWatts' kit page stops at 3,763 Wh and mentions the Jackery 10 kWh kit only in passing ($8,499, unavailable), excluding it. Solar Waypoint (cited) has no prices or shipping; EnergySage (cited) has no kit in this size and no shipping states. So rivals hold fragments of the shipping picture, not the table. solargenadvisor.com/best-solar-generator-kits failed to load (certificate error) and the other uncited results were not opened, so this is not a 3.
decides: It changes the pick. ChatGPT's 'ready-made' pick (Jackery 10 kWh kit, $8,499 card) is a pre-order at the highest price per Wh in the range, and its 'value' pick (Anker S5000 10 kWh + 2×400 W) ships in 11–12 weeks. Its $5,588.99 Anker E10 card holds 6.144 kWh, outside the size line. Under the ships-now rule the candidate pick is Sun Gold Power SGR-8K10E (store feed says available, lowest $/Wh, the only kit whose panels refill it in one sunny day), stated plainly as a wire-it-yourself component kit, not a wheeled plug-in station; its dispatch state still needs opening on the product page. BLUETTI Apex 300 + 2× B300K + 2× 500 W ($5,224.05 link) is the plug-and-play option for a shopper who can wait until late January 2027, and the 2× 200 W version ($4,369.05 link) is the cheapest plug-and-play row. Two linked BLUETTI kits fit the size line, so the page is not a skip.
